title: 'Pustakanchi Parasbag' Blooms in ZP Schools
summary: 28th September: Rotary Club of Boisar-Tarapur launched “Sajli-Fulali, Pustakanchi Parasbag” (A Garden of Books), based on Secretary Rekhesh Jain’s concept, for ZP schools.
description: 28th September: Rotary Club of Boisar-Tarapur launched “Sajli-Fulali, Pustakanchi Parasbag” (A Garden of Books), based on Secretary Rekhesh Jain’s concept, for ZP schools. At the ZP Government Library Office, District Library Officer Mr. Prashant Patil distributed 10 book boxes, each containing 131 selected books for Std. 1–4. The Club plans 100 boxes across Palghar district. Mr. Patil stressed reading and the vision of “A Library in Every Village.” Present were President Dr. Pravin Vaishya, First Lady Archana Vaishya, Secretary Rekhesh Jain, Past Presidents Rakesh Mishra, Ramesh Mittal, Jagdish Bhute, Vilas Shahapure, Vaishali Shinde, JT Secretary Kaushal Srivastav, Prashant Baviskar, O.P. Singh, Ratnasingh, Project Chairman Sandhya Shahapure, Coordinator & President-Elect Alka Jain, and ZP school students.
